name: jg-product-design-plugin-codex
description: Product-design skills for demand management, prototype design and editing, review and weekly meeting minutes, UI acceptance, prototype self-check, delivery map updates, and ZenTao SR preparation. Includes Tableau data processing, refreshable Excel extracts, live database connections, and evidence-based analysis. Includes technical bid preparation and review.

interface.shortDescription: Product workflows, prototypes, reviews, delivery maps, and Tableau analysis.
interface.longDescription: The maintained Codex source for the product-design workflow. It supports rough-demand to PRD discussion, security-triggered requirements, HTML prototype generation and local annotation editing, design-review memos, product weekly meeting host scripts and final minutes, browser-based UI acceptance, prototype self-check, prototype-to-PRD backfill, R&D Word requirement specifications, and ZenTao SR preparation. Monthly tracking workbooks can update product A and product B delivery maps with customer mapping checks and preview publishing. The product A and product B delivery-map skills share update, verification and publishing procedures while using each product's local configuration and data source. Tableau data processing separates raw data from calculations, packages refreshable Excel extracts, uses live database connections, and verifies worksheet scope, matching evidence, deviations, and sharing. Technical bid preparation preserves target templates, maps requirements and evidence, verifies commitments, and supports multiple projects within one bid package.
